versions.heading: Order of Change of Venue May Be Annulled, When
versions.text: A court which has granted a change of venue shall have the power to annul the order, with consent of the parties, at any time before the papers or transcript are filed in the court to which the venue was changed.
versions.source: Perplexity cached copy of the courts.mo.gov page (pplx_sdk.content.fetch)
